open_source_risks.risk: One exclusive owner for the session lifetime is not established.
Cleanup after a session ends can still run from the panic hook.
Restore consumes saved state before dup2 succeeds.

tools_retained_operations.operations: F_GETFL/F_SETFL set O_NONBLOCK on a live borrowed pipe descriptor; ownership stays with the File.
siginfo_t all-zero validity is a supported-target precondition; waitid uses P_PID/WEXITED/WNOHANG/WNOWAIT; si_pid is read only after success.
process_group(0) precedes a negative-pid process-group kill; the helper ignores kill failure and Child::wait covers only the direct child.
sigaction all-zero validity is a supported-target precondition; source initializes handler, flags, and mask before libc reads the value.
host/launcher must transfer two live, valid, distinct pipe descriptors exclusively and once; environment parsing does not establish ownership. T20-OBS-FD-01 remains open.

tools_retired_test_safety_rationales.disposition: Preserve exact source bytes and hashes as historical evidence; do not present retired helper invariants as active production guarantees.
